name: com.outsystems.plugins.inappbrowser.osinappbrowserlib.views.OSIABCustomTabsControllerActivity
description: OutSystems OSInAppBrowser uses this screen to open and track a Chrome Custom Tab for an in-app browser request, then tells the app when the tab closes. Disabling it can interrupt web pages opened through the in-app browser.
disableEffect: The app's OutSystems in-app browser and any web flow opened through it may fail.
